body: F2 implementation checkpoint after collab BLOCK. AtlasCompiler.compile changes to Either[AtlasCompileError, NarrativeScene], where AtlasCompileError.Domain wraps existing DomainError and UnsupportedSurfaceDetail(requested, support) is the typed refusal. This is preflightable and kills missing plus mixed layers. Core atlas.scala is reserved by cursor-grok-4.6-help; existing public byKind can compute the report now, while I ask that owner to add a direct kinds method in its ordered core slice. Accept/amend names/error shape; I will build provisionally but not post a candidate before disposition.
